title: Every accepted routing rule
description: What GET /api/v1/routing-rules answers and `ingestion gates routing-rules list --json` prints: the newest version of each rule that a person accepted, by name, each retired one included. A rule written by hand stays in the routing-rules.yml of the set in force, and is not listed here. A match's values copy a source's field, so each may be a stranger's text.
